title: Grilled Tamales with Nectarine Salsa and Oysters
description: A fusion dish that combines the flavors of Mexico with the sweetness of nectarines. Grilled tamales are paired with a fresh and spicy salsa made from nectarines, a hint of Mexican chili, and a delicate topping of oysters.
instructions: Place tamales on the grill, turning occasionally, until lightly charred. This should take about 5 minutes per side.
In a bowl, mix together diced nectarines, red onion, jalapeño, and cilantro.
Squeeze lime juice over the mixture and season with salt.
To serve, place a grilled tamale on a plate, top with a spoonful of the nectarine salsa, and finally place an oyster on top.
